scenes.caption: A living shell.
scenes.say: Millions of years ago, a shelled animal lives in a warm sea.

scenes.caption: It dies.
scenes.say: It dies and sinks to the sea floor. Mud and sand cover it.

scenes.caption: Layers build.
scenes.say: Layer on layer builds up. Over a long time, the layers turn to rock.

scenes.caption: A fossil forms.
scenes.say: The shell leaves a fossil in the rock. It stays there for millions of years.

scenes.caption: Weathering.
scenes.say: Wind, rain and frost weather the cliff. The rock crumbles into pieces.

scenes.caption: Erosion and soil.
scenes.say: A river carries bits away. They mix with humus to make soil.

scenes.caption: Found!
scenes.say: A girl finds the fossil in the cliff, just like Mary Anning did.

scenes.caption: In a museum.
scenes.say: Now the fossil sits in a museum. It tells us about life long ago.
